description: This file implements functions related to loose object management in a Git repository, including object mapping, loading, saving, and memory management.

methods.name: int should_use_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Determines if loose object map should be used based on repository's compatibility hash algorithm and git directory presence.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a hash map, cloning the value.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts object ID pairs into the loose object map and updates the oidtree cache.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads a single loose object map from disk and initializes data structures.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Reads all loose object maps for a repository if applicable.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Writes the loose object map to disk.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Writes a single object ID pair to the loose object index file.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds a loose object map entry and writes it to disk if inserted.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped object ID from loose object maps for a given source object ID.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a loose object map.
